title: Retain the common position quadrature in an all-K lower receiver
statement: The exact four-quadrature identity bounds their weighted squares by(8K+4)Hhop+8KTrT. The charge-current commutator retains a common-position pressure term; controlling it solely by total depletion loses the desired order. The resulting argument is LOWER only, with no acquired upper partition/state approximation.
